  - main:
    - link "School lessons":

      - text: School lessons
    - text: CLASS 12 · PROBABILITY
    - heading "Variance" [level=1]
    - paragraph: "Variance is the probability-weighted average of squared distances from the mean. It measures spread: how far, on average, values lie from the center."
    - text: 18 min · ADVANCED · CONCEPT · statistics
    - navigation "Lesson sections":
      - button "Spread"
      - button "Calculate"
      - button "Compare"
      - button "Formula"
      - button "Practice"
    - heading "Choose distribution" [level=3]
    - button "Distribution A" [pressed]
    - button "Distribution B"
    - text: Spread control More spread
    - status "Spread control More spread 0": "A: 0%"
    - slider "Spread control": "0"
    - text: Mode
    - combobox "Probability model":
      - option "Valid distribution (Σp = 1)" [selected]
      - option "Equal probabilities (1/3 each)"
      - option "Point mass at the mean"
    - button "Reset all":
      - img
      - text: Reset all
    - heading "Distance from mean → Square → Weight → Contribution" [level=2]
    - group "Probability masses and distances from the mean; drag outer points to change spread":
      - text: p(x) x -2 -1 0 1 2 3 4
      - slider "Left spread handle": p = 0.25 |0 − 1| = 1
      - text: p = 0.5
      - slider "Right spread handle": p = 0.25 |2 − 1| = 1
      - text: μ = 1
    - table:
      - rowgroup:
        - row "x 0 1 2":
          - rowheader "x"
          - cell "0"
          - cell "1"
          - cell "2"
        - row "p(x) 0.25 0.5 0.25":
          - rowheader "p(x)"
          - cell "0.25"
          - cell "0.5"
          - cell "0.25"
        - row "Deviation x − μ -1 0 1":
          - rowheader "Deviation x − μ"
          - cell "-1"
          - cell "0"
          - cell "1"
        - row "Squared (x − μ)² 1 0 1":
          - rowheader "Squared (x − μ)²"
          - cell "1"
          - cell "0"
          - cell "1"
        - row "Square (area) 1 0 1":
          - rowheader "Square (area)"
          - cell "1"
          - cell "0"
          - cell "1"
        - row "Weighted square p(x)(x − μ)² 0.25 0.25 0 0 0.25 0.25":
          - rowheader "Weighted square p(x)(x − μ)²"
          - cell "0.25 0.25":
            - text: "0.25"
            - progressbar "Variance contribution 1"
          - cell "0 0":
            - text: "0"
            - progressbar "Variance contribution 2"
          - cell "0.25 0.25":
            - text: "0.25"
            - progressbar "Variance contribution 3"
    - strong: Variance = ∑ p(x)(x − μ)² = 0.25 + 0 + 0.25 = 0.5
    - strong: Standard deviation σ = √Var(X) ≈ 0.7071
    - article:
      - heading "Calculations (Distribution A)" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "Method 1: Var(X) = ∑(x − μ)²p(x) = 0.5"
      - paragraph: "Method 2: Var(X) = E(X²) − [E(X)]²"
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "x 0 1 2":
            - rowheader "x"
            - cell "0"
            - cell "1"
            - cell "2"
          - row "x² 0 1 4":
            - rowheader "x²"
            - cell "0"
            - cell "1"
            - cell "4"
          - row "p(x) 0.25 0.5 0.25":
            - rowheader "p(x)"
            - cell "0.25"
            - cell "0.5"
            - cell "0.25"
          - row "x²p(x) 0 0.5 1":
            - rowheader "x²p(x)"
            - cell "0"
            - cell "0.5"
            - cell "1"
      - paragraph: E(X²) = 1.5 E(X) = 1
      - paragraph:
        - text: Var(X) = 1.5 − 1² = 0.5
        - img
    - article:
      - heading "Why squaring matters" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Without squaring, positive and negative deviations cancel.
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "x − μ -1 0 1":
            - rowheader "x − μ"
            - cell "-1"
            - cell "0"
            - cell "1"
          - row "p(x) 0.25 0.5 0.25":
            - rowheader "p(x)"
            - cell "0.25"
            - cell "0.5"
            - cell "0.25"
          - row "(x − μ)p(x) -0.25 0 0.25":
            - rowheader "(x − μ)p(x)"
            - cell "-0.25"
            - cell "0"
            - cell "0.25"
      - paragraph: Sum = 0 (cancels out).
      - paragraph: Squaring makes all contributions nonnegative and reflects distance.
    - article:
      - heading "Common misconception" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: Common misconception
      - paragraph: Mean is the center. Variance is the spread.
      - paragraph: "Same mean, different spread (μ = 1 for both):"
      - paragraph: "Distribution A: Var = 0.5 Distribution B: Var = 2"
      - text: B is more spread out.
    - heading "Compare spreads (same mean μ = 1)" [level=2]
    - article:
      - 'button "Distribution A: {0, 1, 2}"'
      - img "Distribution A, mean 1, variance 0.5": "-2 -1 0 1 2 3 4 0.25 0.5 0.25"
      - paragraph: Var = 0.5 σ ≈ 0.7071
    - article:
      - 'button "Distribution B: {-1, 1, 3}"'
      - img "Distribution B, mean 1, variance 2": "-2 -1 0 1 2 3 4 0.25 0.5 0.25"
      - paragraph: Var = 2 σ ≈ 1.4142
    - paragraph: Both distributions are symmetric about μ = 1. B has positive probability farther from the mean, producing larger squared distances and larger variance.
    - article:
      - heading "Worked example" [level=2]
      - paragraph: A spinner lands on 0, 1, 2 with probabilities 1/4, 1/2, 1/4.
      - paragraph: μ = 1
      - paragraph: Var(X) = (−1)²(1/4) + 0²(1/2) + 1²(1/4) = 0.50
      - paragraph: σ = √0.50 ≈ 0.7071
    - article:
      - heading "Quick practice" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "Distribution: {0, 1, 2} with p = {1/4, 1/2, 1/4}."
      - text: 1. Mean
      - spinbutton "Practice Mean"
      - text: 2. Variance
      - spinbutton "Practice Variance"
      - text: 3. Standard deviation
      - spinbutton "Practice Standard deviation"
      - button "Check answers"
    - article:
      - heading "Explore" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Move the spread control while keeping ∑p = 1.
      - paragraph: Compare A and B, then verify each squared contribution in the calculation table.
      - button "Explore Distribution B"
